title.narrative: Winterisation assistance to conflict-affected communities in frontline and hard-to-reach areas in Donetska, Kharkivska, and Zaporizka oblasts.

description.narrative: ltpgtWith this proposal, the Estonian Refugee Council (ERC) continues its efforts to provide winterization humanitarian assistance frontline and hard-to-reach areas in Donetska, Kharkivska, and Zaporizka oblasts with a local partner. Over a period of 6 months, ERC will carry out an assistance program to provide cash and in-kind support for winter energy needs by distributing coal, firewood, briquettes, and pellets for home solid fuel heaters for 2130 HHs (4,260 Individuals) in Donetska, Kharkivska, and Zaporizka oblast.ltbrgtltbrgtThe proposal is developed in line with the 2024 Ukraine Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan (HNRP) objectives, focusing on the shelter/NFI cluster and targeting three regions: Donetska, Kharkivska, and Zaporizka oblast based on the Winterisation Needs of East Hub Oblasts. This project will be implemented directly by the ERC Country Office in partnership with ltbgtYes lt/bgtNNGO, which has extensive experience and operational capacities within these locations. The choice of target regions and vulnerable households to be reached by ERC is based on the Shelter Response Support Assessment and the Cold Spot Assessment. ERC’s own monitoring and needs assessments from these areas confirm the high need for assistance in these regions for both cash and in-kind support.ltbrgtltbrgtCash modality will be prioritised in areas where markets are accessible, functional, and reliable in Donetska, Kharkviska and Zaporizka oblasts (Kramatorkyi, Kharkivskyi and Zapoizkyi raions), and will make up to 80% of the indicated target.ltbrgtltbrgtIn-kind modality will be prioritised in areas where markets are unavailable, lack capacity, or where the target population cannot access markets or belongs to vulnerable categories unable to access nearby markets. In-kind assistance will be provided by ERC local partner Yes NNGO in Donestka and Zaporizka oblasts (Kramatoskyi and Zaporizkyi raions) and will make up to 20% of the indicated target.ltbrgtltbrgtERC is confident that the proposed intervention is a valuable addition to the humanitarian operations in Ukraine, alleviating human suffering and securing the basic needs of the target populations). Planning, monitoring, and reporting will adhere to Activity SN108: Winter Energy recommendations in the Shelter ltbrgtlt/pgt
